alex: Heads-up: we should reconcile semantics for migrating allocations between host and GPU when we do prefix eviction. I'm seeing a few surprises when KV cache stays resident but tensor meta moves.

maria: Can you paste an example? is this host staging vs host-backed pages?

alex: Yep. repro: model loads ~40GB > vram, we evict older kvs to host but keep small tensors on gpu. When we migrate a tensor that still has an active CUDA pointer we end up double-alloc'ing on host and gpu for a short window.

tj: We saw similar in async-offload. Root cause was allocator returns pinned pointer before migration completes. maybe syncpoints missing.

jin: Agree. Proposal: two-phase migration API: reserve/migrate/commit with explicit state transitions. That avoids visible double-alloc.

irene: Tradeoff: extra state machine, more locks. but simplifies correctness. can we do lock-free with sequence numbers?

alex: Sketch: callers call `migrate(reserve_size)` -> runtime returns a handle. runtime does background copy to host; `commit(handle)` makes host view primary and frees gpu mapping. `abort` for fallback.

sam: What about partial migration and lazy copy? i.e., only migrate pages on first access. reduces copy bandwidth.

maria: Would need page-fault handler or read-proxy; could be heavy on latency SLOs.

tj: Also need to consider memory accounting and quota. reserve should decrement gpu quota so schedulers don't overcommit.

jin: Code snippet for handle API suggestion: ```c++
struct MigrateHandle { uint64_t id; size_t size; enum {RESERVED, COPYING, COMMITTED, ABORTED} state; };
// calls:
uint64_t reserve_migrate(void* ptr, size_t size);
bool commit(uint64_t id);
void abort(uint64_t id);
```

alex: Nice. Can we piggyback KV cache refcount changes? i.e., increment on reserve so cache doesn't evict mid-copy.

irene: Refcounts are fine but we must avoid stalls: reserve should be fast path and non-blocking.

sam: Operationally: need metrics: migrate_latency, migrate_bandwidth, abort_rate. Also expose per-tenant policy: eager vs lazy.

mem-bot: mem-bot: scheduled compaction run at 2025-06-12T08:00Z — no interrupts.

alex: Thanks. Action items: jin to prototype handle API, tj to audit allocator syncpoints, maria to spec quota semantics. We'll reconvene next Tues. cc @irene @sam :thumbsup:
